orders.not-found: The requested order was not found
orders.soft-deleted: Order was soft deleted (hidden from the customer).

cancel.not-cancellable: This order can no longer be cancelled.

override.not-allowed: This override cannot move the order to that status from where it is now.

invoice.title: Order confirmation / receipt
invoice.disclaimer: This is not a tax invoice.

email-confirm.subject: Order received — awaiting payment
email-confirm.body: We've received your order. It's awaiting payment — nothing has been charged yet.

email-transfer.subject: Complete your order by bank transfer
email-transfer.body: Your order is reserved. Send the transfer below to complete it — include the reference so we can match your payment.

email-transfer-expired.subject: Your order was cancelled — no transfer received
email-transfer-expired.body: We didn't receive your bank transfer in time, so this order has been cancelled and its items released.

email-product-unavailable.subject: Your order was cancelled — an item is no longer available
email-product-unavailable.body: The following item is no longer available, so this order has been cancelled and nothing was charged:

orders.insufficient-stock: Some items on this order are no longer available in the quantity requested — see `details.lines`.
orders.product-unavailable: One or more products on this order are no longer available — see `details.lines`.
